knowledge.name: Synthetic condition-monitoring snapshot
knowledge.detail: Eight fictional transformers, switchgear panels, cables and lines with health, anomaly and 30, 90 and 180-day failure risk.

knowledge.name: Stores and lead times
knowledge.detail: Materials for each asset with quantity needed, stock in stores and supplier lead time in days.

knowledge.name: Completed job field records
knowledge.detail: Fictional completed work orders with required measurements, recorded values, parts replaced and condition grades.

knowledge.name: Fleet and replacement plan
knowledge.detail: Fleet health by asset class and the replacement pipeline with capital by financial year.

intelligence_processing.name: Failure probability ranking
intelligence_processing.detail: Ranks assets by 90-day then 180-day failure probability and applies the work order and planning thresholds.

intelligence_processing.name: Work order draft builder
intelligence_processing.detail: Assembles the preventive work order from asset history, the anomaly, crew and outage plan; skips assets below the threshold.

intelligence_processing.name: Parts pre-planning
intelligence_processing.detail: Reserves stocked items and computes an order-by date from each part's lead time, flagging long-lead parts first.

intelligence_processing.name: Field record completeness check
intelligence_processing.detail: Holds the register update until every required measurement is on the completed job's record.

intelligence_processing.name: Capital pipeline rollup
intelligence_processing.detail: Totals replacement capital by financial year for the investment committee.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio asset health assistant
clients_user_interface.detail: Hosts the pilot with four skills and two synthetic knowledge files; the package stays Draft until review.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat
clients_user_interface.detail: Runs the single-file GridAssetMaintenanceAgent locally with deterministic routing over the asset snapshot.

clients_user_interface.name: Power Apps field job form
clients_user_interface.detail: Where field engineers capture measurements and parts replaced; the agent reads the record it produces.

management_reporting.name: Risk-prioritized backlog
management_reporting.detail: Every monitored asset ranked with health, 30, 90 and 180-day failure probability and the recommended action.

management_reporting.name: Fleet health and replacement plan
management_reporting.detail: Average health, poor condition and 180-day risk by asset class, with the replacement pipeline and capital by year.

management_reporting.name: Asset health acceptance evidence
management_reporting.detail: Four locked reliability engineer, planner and director cases, one per operation, with exact anchors.

tools.name: Portable GridAssetMaintenanceAgent
tools.detail: Single-file Python BasicAgent with four deterministic read-only operations over synthetic records.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the four-skill package; publishing stays with an authorized reviewer.

tools.name: Microsoft Dataverse and Power Automate
tools.detail: Cited read-only seam: Power Automate brings the condition-monitoring feed, stores and fixed asset data into Dataverse tables.

tools.name: Dynamics 365 Field Service
tools.detail: Raises the preventive work order only after a maintenance planner approves the draft.

tools.name: Power BI
tools.detail: Shows fleet health and the replacement pipeline to asset management leadership.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic utility evidence boundary
supporting_features.detail: Every substation, asset, crew, person, work order, measurement and capital figure is invented.

supporting_features.name: No work order, order, or register write
supporting_features.detail: Never raises a work order, orders or reserves a part, assigns a crew, or changes a register.

supporting_features.name: Engineer approval gate
supporting_features.detail: The planner approves each work order, the reliability engineer each register update, the committee the replacement plan.

supporting_features.name: Four routable operations
supporting_features.detail: Risk ranking, work order draft, register update check and replacement plan each answer one bounded question.

supporting_features.name: Controlled future writes
supporting_features.detail: Any later write needs authenticated tools, authorization checks, explicit human approval, and an audit log.
